tools.description: Search the UK stores Vouchernaut lists by name or category ("flowers", "Currys", "phone cases"). Each store comes with how many live codes and deals it has, its best few offers with their codes and tracked links, a link to shop there and its vouchernaut.com page.

tools.description: Every live discount code and deal Vouchernaut lists for one UK store, in the order its store page shows them: the code itself, what it saves, its terms and end date, how many shoppers said it worked or failed, and a link that opens the store with the offer. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product, by its `ref` ("<store>/<product>") or its vouchernaut.com page: every variant's price and stock, the store's best discount code that covers it and the price after it, its price history (lowest, typical, now), delivery, the same product at other stores and a tracked link to buy.

tools.name: price_drops
tools.description: Products across UK stores whose price fell in the last 30 days from a price the store had held for at least 28 days, biggest fall first. Each comes with the old and new price and a tracked link. Narrow by search words, product type, store or price.

Shares are quotable ("one in three readers") only once a poll has 100 answers. Without `poll`, it lists the polls.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Vouchernaut, a UK shopping guide: stores with discount codes, products and their prices, phones on its phone finder, and its buying guides. Each result has an id, a title and its page's URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one result from search: a store's live codes and deals with their links, a product's price and code, a phone's deals, or a buying guide.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Public sink: get_poll_result, find_software · Destructive: airport_parking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Public sink: get_poll_result, find_software · Destructive: airport_parking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
